name: aqua
role: water family (sun-mint #98f4e6 at the surface -> turquoise #35c8e6 -> #25b0e6 -> cerulean #2283d8 -> #1f58b8 floor), the aqua rim light from below on every toy, bubble film (cyan end)

name: deep
role: HUD chips and tagline pill (gradient #2c5399 -> #1a3772), menu label ink on the frosted pills, logo sticker outline (#26336e), caustic / vignette shadows

name: coral
role: candy platforms: calm coral body (#ffa391 -> #f27f86 -> #c4546f, each slab drifts a little toward peach #ffb98a or bubblegum #ff7fb0), 1UP label #ff7a8a; deliberately lower chroma than Fizz / Crabbit so heroes and threats stay louder than the slabs

name: lemon
role: selected menu pill, HI SCORE label, score popups (inflated), Nibbler warning ring (#ffa81f), Springle crest / spring, sun glow tint (#fff8cd)

name: lilac
role: Pop body (#aa9bff) and Jellop jelly, 2UP label, bubble film (lilac / magenta band), far-reef coral silhouettes (#c9b7ff)

name: mint
role: Springle body family (#4fd682), logo Z, EXTEND bead, far-reef domes (#aef2e6), positive accents

name: cream
role: UI text, belly patches, logo sticker border, frosting caps (#fff0dc -> #ffd2b4), rice, god rays (#fffce1)

name: ink
role: glossy eyes, text on light chips, contact-shadow tint, thin contours

name: sand-clay
role: outer frame: walls, floor, ceiling (matte clay gradient #f7cf9f -> #e8a47d -> #c8766e) with pebble inlays, EXTEND wells (berry #703054 carved into it)

name: bubblegum
role: Fizz body (gills #ff3f8e), P1 colour, logo F / P; angry state swaps the species colour for crimson #e8344f
